title: Source countries
markdown:
### Geographic Origins of Attack Traffic

In aggregate data covering all products, Brazil rose from rank `10` [F-024] to rank `3` [F-024] with a `246.4%` [F-024] increase in attack volume. This aggregate figure is based on IP geolocation of the attacking infrastructure, not attribution of the attacker. VPNs, proxies and compromised hosts are common. Summed across products like email gateway and firewall, one attack can be seen by more than one product, so this may overcount attacks.

For firewall traffic, China was the top source country of attacks in 2026, accounting for `895,100` [F-017] volume and `20.0%` [F-017] of all attack volume. Brazil emerged as the second-largest source country of attacks with a `211.6%` [F-016] increase from the previous year. This volume reached `668,293` [F-016], representing `14.9%` [F-016] of firewall traffic.

For email gateway products, Chinese-origin attacks increased by `55.7%` [F-010] to become the top attacking country with `205,490` [F-010] blocked incidents. Brazil became the third-largest attacking country in 2026, jumping from rank `10` [F-009] to rank `3` [F-009] with a `549.0%` [F-009] increase in attacks. This product saw `154,209` [F-009] incidents and a share of `15.0%` [F-009].
